<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot xmlns:xacro="http://wiki.ros.org/xacro" name="$(arg name)">
  <xacro:include filename="$(find aic_description)/urdf/ur_gz.urdf.xacro"/>

  <!--
    Project-only depth sensors for port visibility annotation.  The official
    RGB sensors remain unchanged.  Visibility only samples four projected
    corners, so these sensors use lower resolution and rate to avoid slowing
    every simulator worker during motion.
  -->
  <xacro:macro name="annotation_depth_camera" params="name tf_prefix">
    <gazebo reference="${tf_prefix}sensor_link">
      <sensor name="${name}_annotation_depth" type="depth_camera">
        <pose>0 0 0 0 0 0</pose>
        <update_rate>5.0</update_rate>
        <topic>/${name}/depth_image</topic>
        <always_on>true</always_on>
        <frame_id>${tf_prefix}sensor_link</frame_id>
        <camera name="${name}_annotation_depth">
          <camera_info_topic>/${name}/depth_camera_info</camera_info_topic>
          <optical_frame_id>${tf_prefix}optical</optical_frame_id>
          <image>
            <width>576</width>
            <height>512</height>
            <format>R_FLOAT32</format>
          </image>
          <horizontal_fov>0.8718</horizontal_fov>
          <clip>
            <near>0.07</near>
            <far>20</far>
          </clip>
        </camera>
      </sensor>
    </gazebo>
  </xacro:macro>

  <xacro:annotation_depth_camera name="left_camera" tf_prefix="left_camera/"/>
  <xacro:annotation_depth_camera name="center_camera" tf_prefix="center_camera/"/>
  <xacro:annotation_depth_camera name="right_camera" tf_prefix="right_camera/"/>
</robot>
angle_frame: port local XZ; outward=-Z; camera optical +Z looks at port; optical +Y=port +Y
gt_contract: fixed task-board entrance snapshot, checked unchanged before/after capture

<sdf version="1.9">
  <world name="aic_world">

    <scene>
      <ambient>0 0 0</ambient>
      <grid>false</grid>
      
      <background>0.15 0.15 0.15 1</background>
    </scene>

    <gui fullscreen="0">

      
      <plugin filename="MinimalScene" name="3D View">
        <gz-gui>
          <title>3D View</title>
          <property type="bool" key="showTitleBar">false</property>
          <property type="string" key="state">docked</property>
        </gz-gui>

        <engine>ogre2</engine>

        

        <camera_clip>
          <near>0.01</near>
          <far>500</far>
        </camera_clip>
        <camera_pose>0.95 -0.1 1.3 0.0 0.0 3.14</camera_pose>
      </plugin>

      <plugin filename="ComponentInspector" name="Component inspector">
        <gz-gui>
          <property type="string" key="state">docked_collapsed</property>
        </gz-gui>
      </plugin>

      
      <plugin filename="EntityTree" name="Entity tree">
        <gz-gui>
          <property type="string" key="state">docked_collapsed</property>
        </gz-gui>
      </plugin>

      
      <plugin filename="ViewAngle" name="View angle">
        <gz-gui>
          <property type="string" key="state">docked_collapsed</property>
        </gz-gui>
      </plugin>

      
      <plugin filename="ApplyForceTorque">
        <gz-gui>
          <property type="string" key="state">docked_collapsed</property>
        </gz-gui>
      </plugin>

      
      <plugin filename="VisualizeContacts" name="Visualize Contacts">
        <gz-gui>
          <property key="state" type="string">docked</property>
        </gz-gui>
      </plugin>

    </gui>

    <physics name="2ms" type="bullet-featherstone">
      <max_step_size>0.002</max_step_size>
      <real_time_factor>1.0</real_time_factor>
    </physics>
    
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-user-commands-system" name="gz::sim::systems::UserCommands">
    </plugin>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-physics-system" name="gz::sim::systems::Physics">
      <engine><filename>gz-physics-bullet-featherstone-plugin</filename></engine>
    </plugin>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-sensors-system" name="gz::sim::systems::Sensors">
      <render_engine>ogre2</render_engine>
      <global_illumination type="vct">
        <enabled>true</enabled>
        <resolution>256 256 256</resolution>
        <octant_count>1 1 1</octant_count>
        <bounce_count>3</bounce_count>
        <high_quality>false</high_quality>
        <anisotropic>true</anisotropic>
        <thin_wall_counter>1.0</thin_wall_counter>
        <conserve_memory>true</conserve_memory>
        <debug_vis_mode>none</debug_vis_mode>
      </global_illumination>
    </plugin>
    <plugin filename="ScoringPlugin" name="aic_gazebo::ScoringPlugin">
    </plugin>
    <plugin filename="WorldSdfGeneratorPlugin" name="aic_gazebo::WorldSdfGeneratorPlugin">
        <save_world_delay_s>0.1</save_world_delay_s>
        <save_world_path>/tmp/aic.sdf</save_world_path>
				<save_world_delay_s>0.0</save_world_delay_s>
    </plugin>
    <plugin filename="gz-sim-contact-system" name="gz::sim::systems::Contact">
    </plugin>

    <gravity>0 0 -9.8</gravity>

    <light type="spot" name="enclosure_light">
      <pose>0 0 2.5 0 0 0</pose>
      <cast_shadows>true</cast_shadows>
      <diffuse>1 1 1 1</diffuse>
      <intensity>0.27999999999999997</intensity>
      <specular>.1 .1 .1 1</specular>
      <attenuation>
        <range>2</range>
        <constant>1.0</constant>
        <linear>0.01</linear>
        <quadratic>0.001</quadratic>
      </attenuation>
      <spot>
        <inner_angle>0.1</inner_angle>
        <outer_angle>2</outer_angle>
        <falloff>1.0</falloff>
      </spot>
      <visualize>false</visualize>
    </light>

    <light type="point" name="ceiling_01">
      <pose>2 2 6 0 0 0</pose>
      <cast_shadows>false</cast_shadows>
      <diffuse>1 1 1 1</diffuse>
      <intensity>1.3999999999999999</intensity>
      <specular>.1 .1 .1 1</specular>
      <attenuation>
        <range>9</range>
        <constant>1.0</constant>
        <linear>0.01</linear>
        <quadratic>0.001</quadratic>
      </attenuation>
      <visualize>false</visualize>
    </light>

    <light type="point" name="ceiling_02">
      <pose>-2 -2 6 0 0 0</pose>
      <cast_shadows>false</cast_shadows>
      <diffuse>1 1 1 1</diffuse>
      <intensity>1.3999999999999999</intensity>
      <specular>.1 .1 .1 1</specular>
      <attenuation>
        <range>9</range>
        <constant>1.0</constant>
        <linear>0.01</linear>
        <quadratic>0.001</quadratic>
      </attenuation>
      <visualize>false</visualize>
    </light>

    <include>
      <uri>model://Enclosure</uri>
      <name>enclosure</name>
      <static>true</static>
    </include>

    <include>
      <uri>model://Enclosure Walls</uri>
      <name>enclosure walls</name>
      <static>true</static>
    </include>

    <include>
      <uri>model://Floor</uri>
      <name>floor</name>
      <static>true</static>
    </include>

    
    
  </world>
</sdf>
